title: Experience concept-demo file
description: Composition plan for one standalone concept demo under /demos/: its shots, their beats, and the narrative segment ids each beat carries, in reading order. Holds no visible text. A demo is not a story Scene: it has no pacing plan, no part, and its page is built by build/demos.ts rather than the story runtime. See docs/concept-demos.md.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; not part of the data.

id.description: Demo id; also the directory of its page and of its code under src/demos/.

titleChapter.description: The chapter whose localized title names this demo.

cue.description: Optional staging cue the demo's code may look up, so code addresses a moment by what happens in it rather than by a beat id or an index.

titleSection.description: Optional: a story section of titleChapter whose localized title names this demo instead of the chapter's, for a second demo drawn from the same chapter.

ground.description: Optional: the ground the figures stand on, light when absent. A dark ground (the night wood, the court) gives the engraved figures a paper rim so they keep their edge; see docs/art-trials.md.

joinsPrevious.description: Optional: true when this demo's first frame is the previous demo's last, one moment of the book across two pages (see docs/concept-demos.md, Joins). The index deals such cards over the card before.

pictures.description: Optional: per locale, a picture to draw in place of another, for a picture whose sense rides on a word of that locale's text. Keyed by locale id, then by the name the demo's code knows the picture by; the value is the name of the picture to draw instead. The Cheshire Cat's pig, or fig: where a locale's rhyme for pig is a lid, the second picture is a lid. A locale without an entry draws the pictures the code names.
